services.agency_name: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

requirements.title: Completed ePassport application
requirements.description: Complete the official online ePassport application with accurate personal and demographic information.

requirements.title: Identity and civil-status documents
requirements.description: Provide the identity, citizenship, birth, marriage or other civil-status documents required for the applicant category.

requirements.title: Passport-size photograph
requirements.description: Provide a passport-size photograph that meets the portal requirements.

requirements.title: Biometric attendance
requirements.description: Attend the selected registration centre for verification and biometric capture.

fees.name: Passport application fee
fees.description: The amount depends on passport type and processing category. Confirm the current official tariff before payment.

faqs.question: Can the whole application be completed online?
faqs.answer: Pre-registration starts online, but the applicant must attend the selected registration centre for verification and biometrics.

faqs.question: Where do I apply?
faqs.answer: Use the official ePassport portal and select an authorised registration centre during the application.

documents.name: Identity and citizenship supporting documents
documents.description: Category-specific identity, citizenship and civil-status documents requested by the portal.

locations.name: Immigration Headquarters
locations.address: West Wing Government Building, Victoria Avenue

services.agency_name: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

requirements.title: Valid travel document
requirements.description: A valid passport or other accepted travel document is required.

requirements.title: Visa-category supporting documents
requirements.description: Provide documents supporting the purpose of travel, accommodation, sponsorship or invitation as required.

requirements.title: Online application
requirements.description: Complete the official Malawi eVisa application form.

fees.name: Visa fee
fees.description: The fee depends on nationality and visa category. A convenience or processing fee may also apply.

faqs.question: How do I apply for a Malawi visa?
faqs.answer: Apply through the official eVisa portal, upload the required documents, pay using a supported card and monitor email notifications.

faqs.question: Are requirements the same for every traveller?
faqs.answer: No. Requirements vary by nationality, purpose of travel and visa category.

documents.name: Passport biodata page
documents.description: A clear copy of the valid travel document biodata page.

documents.name: Visa-category supporting documents
documents.description: Invitation, accommodation, itinerary, sponsor or other documents applicable to the selected category.

services.agency_name: Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services

requirements.title: Completed permit application
requirements.description: Complete the prescribed permit application form.

requirements.title: Applicant supporting documents
requirements.description: Provide identity, qualification and category-specific supporting documents.

requirements.title: Employer or sponsor documents
requirements.description: Provide the required supporting documents from the employer or sponsor in Malawi.

fees.name: Temporary Employment Permit fee
fees.description: Confirm the current permit tariff with Immigration before payment.

faqs.question: Where can the application be submitted?
faqs.answer: Through a Malawi foreign mission, a sponsor in Malawi, Immigration Headquarters in Blantyre, or regional offices in Lilongwe and Mzuzu.

faqs.question: Can an employer submit on behalf of the applicant?
faqs.answer: A sponsor or employer in Malawi may submit the application with the required supporting documents.

documents.name: Permit application form
documents.description: Completed prescribed Temporary Employment Permit application form.

documents.name: Applicant and sponsor supporting documents
documents.description: Identity, qualifications, employment and sponsor documents required for the category.

services.service_name: Register a company limited by guarantee

requirements.title: Proposed company information
requirements.description: Provide the proposed company name, registered office and objects.

requirements.title: Directors and members information
requirements.description: Provide identification and particulars for directors, members or guarantors.

requirements.title: Constitutional documents
requirements.description: Submit the memorandum, articles or other prescribed incorporation documents.

fees.name: Registration fee
fees.description: Official service-page amount recorded on 28 July 2026. Confirm before payment.

faqs.question: Can the registration process be started online?
faqs.answer: Use the Registrar General or CIPC official services portal where the service is available online.

faqs.question: What is a company limited by guarantee?
faqs.answer: It is generally used for non-profit, membership or public-purpose organisations where members guarantee a stated amount rather than hold share capital.

requirements.title: Completed certification application
requirements.description: Complete the official MBS product-certification application form.

requirements.title: Business registration details
requirements.description: Provide the applicant's business registration particulars.

requirements.title: MRA number
requirements.description: Provide the applicant's Malawi Revenue Authority registration number where required.

requirements.title: Factory and product information
requirements.description: Provide details of the factory, manufacturing process and product for assessment.

requirements.title: Applicable Malawi standards
requirements.description: Identify the Malawi standards applicable to the product.

fees.name: Product certification charges
fees.description: Assessment, testing, inspection or licence charges depend on the product and certification scope. Confirm the current quotation with MBS.

faqs.question: Does submitting the application authorise use of the certification mark?
faqs.answer: No. Submission alone does not authorise use of the mark; assessment and formal approval are required.

faqs.question: Will the factory be assessed?
faqs.answer: Factory and product assessment may form part of the certification process depending on the applicable scheme.

documents.description: Business registration evidence and MRA number.

documents.name: Factory and product technical information
documents.description: Technical information supporting assessment against applicable Malawi standards.
